cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I accept your apology for missing my concert. Please don't mark the whole conversation finished yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What else can I say? I've said I'm sorry I missed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's attendance. You left me to ask whether you'd even noticed; we need to deal with that separately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know how to begin, so I kept putting it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Begin there. Say you're sorry I had to start this for you. Please leave 'I didn't know how' until after you've acknowledged the week I spent waiting.
